env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A union member that promotes UnmarshalJSON through an embedded pointer
# reached via an accessible alias decodes through the alias: the trial
# allocates the embedded value with the alias spelling, so the holder
# never names the unexported type the alias stands for. Spelling the
# unaliased element instead fails the build because the unexported name
# is not reachable from the holder package.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok public 11$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^ok public 11$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/unionaliasembed

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
)

type hidden struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

func (h *hidden) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]int64
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["x"]
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("hidden requires x")
	}
	h.X = v
	return nil
}

type Exported = hidden

type Public struct {
	*Exported
}
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/unionaliasembed/lib"
)

type Other struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

func (o *Other) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var m map[string]string
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &m); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	v, ok := m["y"]
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("Other requires y")
	}
	o.Y = v
	return nil
}

type U interface {
	lib.Public | *Other
}

type H struct {
	Item U `json:"item"`
}

func main() {
	var h H
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"item":{"x":11}}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode err:", err)
		return
	}
	if p, ok := h.Item.(lib.Public); ok {
		fmt.Println("ok public", p.X)
		return
	}
	fmt.Printf("WRONG TYPE %T\n", h.Item)
}
